subject.title: feat(memory): carry source actor context into recall

question: Should OpenClaw expose SourceActor participant metadata to plugin tools and memory corpus supplements as a public best-effort attribution contract?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but this is a public plugin/memory API and privacy boundary choice that automation should not settle without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept best-effort SourceActor
options.body: Land this stack after prerequisite ordering and #82985 reconciliation, treating SourceActor as untrusted attribution metadata only.

options.title: Restrict the contract
options.body: Require the PR to narrow or redact the fields before exposing them to plugin tools and memory supplements.

options.title: Pause memory plumbing
options.body: Defer this PR until the generic SourceActor channel contract and memory supplement API direction are settled separately.

recommendation.title: Accept best-effort SourceActor
recommendation.body: Land this stack after prerequisite ordering and #82985 reconciliation, treating SourceActor as untrusted attribution metadata only.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work spans the memory supplement and channel/plugin identity seams where this API boundary needs a decision.
